prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: transparent raster title artwork for a dark fantasy dungeon game's main menu.
Primary request: Create the exact title "Stone & Shadow" in stylized gold lettering. The supplied image is a STYLE/PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY for the existing torchlit stone dungeon menu background; do not reproduce the background.
Text (verbatim): "Stone & Shadow". Spell Stone S-t-o-n-e, ampersand &, Shadow S-h-a-d-o-w. No other words.
Style: premium hand-crafted fantasy title lettering, elegant strong Roman-inspired serif capitals/small caps, subtly weathered antique gold with luminous warm bevel highlights and deep bronze edges, restrained delicate engraved flourishes. Sophisticated, legible, slightly ominous; matches warm torchlight against charcoal and desaturated teal stone.
Composition: a single wide horizontal line, STONE & SHADOW. Large even letterforms with a slightly smaller elegant ampersand. Title has an approximately 5.5:1 width-to-height silhouette and fits in the upper middle of a 1920x1080 menu (intended visible footprint roughly 840x155 pixels), with clean margins and no clipping. Keep ornaments minimal and close to the lettering.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, including between letters; isolated wordmark only. Subtle dark edge/shadow attached closely to glyphs to read over stone, no rectangular plaque, no backdrop, no scene, no badge, no extra icon, no watermark.
